features.name: Authentication System
features.description: User authentication with login, logout, password reset, and first login setup. Supports JWT tokens and role-based access control.

features.name: Farmer Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard for farmers showing farm overview, harvest lots, and key statistics.

features.name: Farm Management
features.description: Manage farms including adding, editing, viewing farms with location data and soil information.

features.name: Harvest Lot Management
features.description: Create and manage harvest lots with traceability information, quality metrics, and processing history.

features.name: Soil Analysis
features.description: Record and manage soil analysis data for farms with detailed metrics and recommendations.

features.name: Weather Monitoring
features.description: Track weather records for farms and integrate with Open-Meteo API for current weather data.

features.name: GAP Compliance Helper
features.description: Assist farmers with Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) compliance tracking and logging.

features.name: Farmer Data Hub
features.description: Centralized data hub for farmers to view all their farm data, harvest lots, soil analyses, and weather records.

features.name: Processor Workbench
features.description: Complete workbench for processors to manage processing batches, drying logs, green bean lots, and invoices.

features.name: Roaster Workbench
features.description: Workbench for roasters to manage inventory, roast batches, and track green bean lots.

features.name: Cupping Sessions
features.description: Manage cupping sessions for quality assessment, competition management, and judge scoring.

features.name: Competition Dashboard
features.description: Dashboard for managing coffee competitions with session tracking and judge management.

features.name: Quality Insights
features.description: Analytics and insights dashboard showing quality metrics, cupping scores, and trends.

features.name: Traceability System
features.description: End-to-end traceability tracking from farm to consumer, showing complete lot history and chain of custody.

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admin interface for managing users, roles, permissions, and transferring ownership.

features.name: Admin Management
features.description: Administrative tools for managing activity types, process types, coffee varieties, and farms.

features.name: Sales Management
features.description: Manage customers, sale orders, invoices, and pricing history.

features.name: Crop Year Management
features.description: Manage crop years for organizing harvest data by season.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: System for managing and displaying user notifications.

features.name: Common UI Components
features.description: Reusable UI components including buttons, inputs, modals, tables, badges, and stat cards.

features.name: Layout Components
features.description: Main layout components including sidebar navigation and header.

features.name: API Utilities
features.description: Base API utility functions for making HTTP requests with authentication.

features.name: AI Integration
features.description: Integration with Google Gemini AI for intelligent features and recommendations.

features.name: Data Context
features.description: React context for managing application-wide data state.

features.name: Custom Hooks
features.description: Reusable React hooks for form handling, edit/delete operations, and data management.

features.name: Utility Functions
features.description: Helper functions for formatting, ID generation, CSV export, and data transformation.

features.name: Database Schema
features.description: Prisma schema defining all database models including Users, Farms, Harvest Lots, Processing Batches, Cupping Sessions, and more.

features.name: Authentication Middleware
features.description: Backend middleware for JWT authentication and authorization.
